morning.caption:
Two tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday and Bahrain said it intercepted Iranian attacks, as Iran said the US blockade must be broken. Brent settled at $92.57 on Friday, before the attacks. US gas is $3.64, down from $3.82 a week ago.

Our read, labeled as judgment: fill up early in the week. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
AAA expects 81.5 million people to travel for Thanksgiving, most by car, and gas is $3.64, down from $4.27 a month ago. Airfares average $800, up 17%. Stock markets close Thursday and close early Friday. Wednesday's PCE inflation report lands before the December 9 Fed meeting. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

evening.caption:
The AI sell-off went global last week. The S&P 500 fell 8.61% and the Nasdaq 10.02%, while Japan's Nikkei dropped 5.06% and South Korea's KOSPI 5.21% on Friday. Nvidia lost 23% on the week. Gold fell 8.92% to $3,537 and the 10 year Treasury yield held at 4.92%. Watch Asia's open tonight, Dell and HP earnings Tuesday and US PCE inflation Wednesday.
